criteria.evidence: Raw Purdue GIS FID 275 names Oliver Perkins Terry House, gives address 205 S Martin Jischke Drive, and supplies a polygon. Cached Purdue Events HTML explicitly says PUPD is located in Terry House; cached Purdue emergency plan independently names TERY, lists PUPD/dispatch, and states one story plus a small utility basement. The rooftop aerial is consistent with a broad low building, although imagery date/clarity limit precise wall interpretation.

criteria.evidence: Reopened mesh bounds compared with the source-footprint XY bounds recorded in evidence; maximum axis-bound discrepancy 0.0000 m. GIS-derived polygon point match and surrounding Esri imagery support campus placement. The local degree-to-meter conversion is explicitly approximate, and the source photo does not georeference the modeled entrance side.
criteria.finding: Orientation of the detailed facade/entrance is not established by source evidence.

criteria.criterion: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
criteria.status: story count and roof form supported; numeric heights estimated
criteria.evidence: Official emergency plan directly states one story with a small utility basement. Purdue Events exterior photo visibly supports a low, flat/parapet roof. The 4.05 m wall and 4.45 m roof/parapet are explicitly estimates inferred from photo proportions; no surveyed vertical dimensions or roof plan were found.
criteria.finding: Do not treat modeled wall/roof elevations as measured; basement is not modeled due to missing dimensions.

criteria.status: major facade pattern supported; detailed placement partly estimated
criteria.evidence: Inspected cached Purdue Events photograph: it visibly shows a horizontal red-brick building, long continuous ribbon glazing with vertical divisions, and a projecting red canopy. Rendered model includes these broad traits and one entrance. The model regularizes pier/mullion spacing and places door/canopy on a representative long frontage; the photograph has no georeferenced direction, and the exact entry position is not verifiable. The cross-bracing and landscaping visible in the photo are omitted.
criteria.finding: Entrance frontage and exact bay rhythm remain unverified; some distinctive photo details are simplified or omitted.
